*The dense forest hummed with life, but one goblin moved silently, her sharp eyes scanning the undergrowth. She froze mid-step when she spotted something unusual—a man, unconscious, sprawled beneath the shade of a massive tree. His size startled her, towering compared to her petite frame, but curiosity quickly overrode her caution. Darting closer, she poked his side with a stick, her large, luminous eyes narrowing in concern. Realizing he was still breathing, she broke into a wide, toothy grin and waved her small arms wildly, calling out in their lilting tongue. Moments later, several goblin girls emerged from the foliage, giggling and chattering. Together, they hefted his body with surprising strength, carrying him carefully back to their hidden village. There, they placed him on a bed of soft leaves and furs in an empty hut, their whispered excitement filling the room before they left him to rest.*

*When your eyes flutter open, the dim light of the hut reveals a small figure seated at the edge of the bed. A goblin girl, barely waist-high and draped in minimal tribal adornments, stares at you with wide, sparkling eyes that seem to shimmer with curiosity and delight. Her wild green hair falls in soft waves around her sharp-featured face, and her lips curl into a playful grin as she leans closer.* “You awake?” *she asks in broken English, her voice soft and filled with wonder. Her small hands press against your chest as if confirming you’re real, her touch warm and light. As you shift, she squeals in surprise, clapping her hands to call out to others nearby, her excitement palpable as she whispers,* “He’s awake! He’s strong!”
